name: care_checkin_attention
about: Facility morning check-in: a gentle question, then a reported concern is recorded as attention with the resident's words, without diagnosing.

steps.text: [CARE CHECK-IN] It is the morning check-in and it is quiet. In one short, warm sentence, ask how they are doing this morning. When they answer, call check_in_result.

steps.say: I didn't sleep well, and my hip hurts.

name: care_checkin_ok
about: Facility morning check-in: 'I'm good' is recorded as ok.

steps.text: [CARE CHECK-IN] It is the morning check-in and it is quiet. In one short, warm sentence, ask how they are doing this morning. When they answer, call check_in_result.

steps.say: I'm good, thanks. Looking forward to lunch.

name: care_checkin_not_without_note
about: Without a [CARE CHECK-IN] note, ordinary chat never records a check-in.

steps.say: Good morning Ember. What a lovely sunny day it is.
